arguments.command:
set -e
CI=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
git reset -q --hard HEAD~1
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='AGENTS.md'; s=open(p).read()
a=" The `commitlint` job in [`ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml) checks every commit of a pull request with [`commitlint.config.js`](commitlint.config.js). `git commit --no-verify` does not skip it."
assert a in s; s=s.replace(a," [`commitlint.config.js`](commitlint.config.js) has the rules."); open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git add AGENTS.md && git commit -q --amend --no-edit --no-verify
# Rebuild the CI commit on top, with the AGENTS.md line
git cherry-pick -n $CI
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='AGENTS.md'; s=open(p).read()
a=" [`commitlint.config.js`](commitlint.config.js) has the rules."
s=s.replace(a," The `commitlint` job in [`ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml) checks every commit of a pull request with [`commitlint.config.js`](commitlint.config.js). `git commit --no-verify` does not skip it."); open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git add -A && git commit -q --no-verify -C $CI
npm run check >/tmp/check.log 2>&1; echo check-with-ci=$?
git format-patch -1 --stdout > /tmp/ci.patch
git reset -q --hard HEAD~1
npm run check >/tmp/check2.log 2>&1; echo check-without-ci=$?
git log --oneline -4; wc -l /tmp/ci.patch
